directive.thread_id: cloud job 2026-11-03: pieces, piece coverage and rows with no test, in the one judge
directive.quote: Brian, 2026-11-03: every piece of every file of his gauntlet tree is a row with a check or a recorded reason, never one row per file and never a byte slice.

job: piece rows: each piece of a document as the row a person keeps in their checks list, one row per identity, a source for each place it stands

distinct_from.why: The one home of old trillion's atomsOf (ported in #104): this file imports atomsOf and lead from it and keeps no copy. Its splitAtoms and atomRecords make a list's note rows from a folder mapping ({ key, heading_path, b3, sources: [{ path, line }], source_count }); a piece row is a check row of list:checks (kind piece, says, checked_by, no_check, sources with section and file identity), a different row for a different list.
atomsOf itself, already moved to tools/documents-as-list-rows/read-data/atoms.mjs; it makes no rows.
Holds a file's pieces as a { key: { identity, no_check } } map in methods/sources.json, not as rows; its sweepAtoms moved to do-work/piece-sweep.mjs (ports/piece-sweep.json).
This tool's own README, describing pieceRow and pieceRows; documentation, not another owner.
The piece sweep: it reads the piece rows a person keeps (the rows pieceRow makes) in place of a sources file and sweeps each source file's pieces; it makes no piece rows.
A test calling pieceRows over made-up text to hold the size of a real list; it tests this job, it does not do it.
The branch tests, calling pieceRow and pieceRows over made-up text to check no piece row names a judge-words selector; they test this job, they do not do it.
The piece sweep's tests, making their made-up piece rows with pieceRows; they test, they do not do this job.
This file's own tests, calling pieceRow, pieceRows and keepPieces over made-up text.
